categories.name: build
categories.evidence: Touches GitHub Actions workflows (.github/workflows/ci.yml, .github/actions/restore-test-assets/action.yml) and CI runner scripts (ci/*, .github/ci-windows.py) to centralize asset retrieval.
categories.rationale: Resolves intermittent CI job failures caused by HTTP 504 gateway timeouts during qa-assets downloads, as reported in #36814. Removing recurring network failures across all CI runners substantially improves CI reliability, which is a key priority for build infrastructure.
